channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'Utter nonsense': Shamita Shetty refutes dating rumours with Deepesh Sharma, says she's 'single and peaceful'
item.description: Shamita lambasted media reports that linked her with Deepesh Sharma after numerous photos and videos of her cosy birthday celebration went viral. She took to her Instagram handle and wrote that she is just friends with Deepesh Sharma.

item.title: US shuts down 200 illegal online pharmacies
item.description: The Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) said the operation, launched nationwide from January 27, led to four arrests and administrative action against several registered entities.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower over weakness in metal stocks
item.description: As of 9.23 am, Sensex lost 254 points, or 0.30 per cent, to reach 83,563, and Nifty eased 85 points, or 0.33 per cent to settle at 25,690.

item.title: 'Karan is not right for you': Tejasswi cries, shouts at BF Karan Kundrra in Dubai-based reality show Desi Bling
item.description: The show centres on a group of wealthy Indians who reside in Dubai and provides an intimate look at their opulent lifestyles.Tall penthouses, fancy cars and extravagant parties serve as the backdrop. There is love, betrayal and drama.

item.title: Why the expiry of the New START treaty is raising alarm over global nuclear stability
item.description: The impending expiry of the New START nuclear arms control treaty has raised serious concerns in the United States Senate over the risk of an unconstrained global nuclear arms race involving the US, Russia and China.

item.title: Govt to issue new I-T forms, rules this month as most taxpayers shift to new regime
item.description: The government will release new income tax return (ITR) forms, implementing rules and detailed FAQs within February to facilitate taxpayers' transition to the new Income Tax Act, 2025, which will come into force from April 1, 2026, CBDT Chairman Ravi Agrawal said.

item.title: Cong MP submits adjournment motion notice in Lok Sabha seeking discussion on India-US trade deal for second day
item.description: Congress MP Manish Tewari has, for the second consecutive day, submitted an adjournment motion in the Lok Sabha seeking a detailed discussion on the recently announced India-US trade deal.

item.title: You can't separate 'Jana Nayagan' from Vijay: Silambarasan amid CBFC row
item.description: Silambarasan TR says that one cannot separate Jana Nayagan from Vijay. He has been in cinema for so many years and has just completed his final film. The film industry should stand by him.

item.title: Delhi Police arrests two Khalistani operatives linked to Gurpatwant Pannun
item.description: Delhi Police has arrested two alleged Khalistani operatives for writing provocative slogans at separate locations in the national capital ahead of Republic Day.

item.title: Goyal defends India–US trade deal amid Oppn protest, says it strengthens economy, safeguards sensitive sectors [Watch]
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal said the agreement will benefit MSMEs, textiles, gems and jewellery, leather and marine sectors, and help India access world-class technologies.
